desc: Ideate approaches and select the marginal-cost threshold method.
Implement the complete Python program with exact integer arithmetic, capped cost accumulation, threshold binary search, and final remaining-budget fill.
Validate on sample tests and edge cases such as M < min(P), N = 1, large M, and ties among marginal costs.
If performance is insufficient, optimize by compressing duplicate P values or grouping threshold evaluations; if correctness fails, switch to an alternative selection method.
